label: Patch Pocket
description: The patch lower pocket is a piece of cloth applied directly to the outside of the jacket over the hip, with its top edge open and all other edges topstitched or hand-stitched to the face cloth. It is the most casual hip pocket option, instantly signalling a relaxed, sporting jacket rather than a formal suit — it is at home on hopsack blazers, tweed sport coats, and Neapolitan soft jackets but is never appropriate on a city business suit. The patch pocket gives a jacket an artisanal, almost improvised quality that has been prized in Italian tailoring since the postwar years.
